main_text.l: unde Maronitarum nominatur secta:
de Joanne Darensi syro; qui nam sint
Melchitae,& qua in re à Jacobitis dif-
fentiant; de aliis sectis in Oriente; Ju-
dicium de Originibus Alexandrinis à
Seldeno editis.
Clarissimo Doctissimoque viro Joan. Mo-rino, Congreg. Orat. Presb. Abraha-mus Ecchellensis Maronita S.P.D.
Nullae profecto sunt mihi gratiae
agen-dae, Morine doctissime,quòd libellum
meum de scriptoribus Chaldaeis{a} ad
te miserim, & quòd misionem non distu-
lerim; sed tibi duplices à me rependen-dae,
quòd illum legere ac perlegere
non sis dedignatus, ad quaestiunculas autem,
quas subinde moves, breviter pro tem-
poris angustia ac præsentium rerum sta-
tu, qui te haud latet, sic respondebo.
I. Joannes ille Maro, qui Commen-
tarios confecit in Liturgiam S. Jacobi,
& à me eo nomine laudatur in meis notis
pag. 135. & alibi, plures quoque alias doc-
tissimas edidit elucubrationes contra
Nesto-
{a} Intelligit catalogum Hebed Jesu.

page.notes: The footnote mark is printed as "(a)" in the text and in the note; it is shown here as {a}. The line "Nesto-" is a word broken at the line end and continues on the next page. The spelling "misionem" is as printed. "diftu-" is printed with a long s, which is shown as a plain s. No catchword or signature is printed.
